discipline: §21: tuned on DEV only, validated on VAL; any later change = new config id + fresh VAL pass

params.curvature_exclusions: trace use ramp|turn_channel, edge.roundabout, road_class motorway|trunk; tag-blind fallback on trace failure/A-to-B
params.stop_anchoring: R16-3 typed per-unit: per-type nearest (anytime units join the L4 angular sweep; fraction units inserted post-sort at slot floor(f*(n+1)) aimed at bracketing vertices; A->B argmin |progress-f| -> detour -> id; used-set dedup; TSP skipped when any fraction stop)
params.stop_waypoint_type: break_through (splits legs -> measured arrivals; probed: through middles do NOT split legs)
params.stop_cover: per-type: mean over requested types of min(1, included/requested) — replaces the scalar count ratio (a covered coffee can no longer hide a missing fuel)
params.exclude_unpaved: wired at both costing sites when avoid.unpaved (probed BEST-EFFORT: no observable change on a gravel-belt corridor); truth = trace edge.unpaved result-scan > UNPAVED_MIN_M (BD-16)
params.preset_simple: owner-facing relabel of chill's exact frozen vector (no new science); 'chill' stays a parse alias

costing_profiles.backroads: ADOPTED — shortest:true, use_living_streets:0 (twisty/backroads presets or pref>=0.7)
costing_profiles.simple: fastest-path (legacy options) — fewer turns is the ask
costing_profiles.fun_default: REFUSED 4× (FUN_DEFAULT_ADOPTED=false); R21-2 (BD-63): with corpus cleanup + R19 urban live, AC 13->8, dirty 1.76->3.49, arterial only -8pp. The default USER experience is fun instead via the APP defaulting to Backroads (DEFAULT_DRAFT.mostlyBackroads=true → the adopted backroads bundle) — raw shortest on characterless briefs stays refused

params.essence_metrics: arterialShareOf + curvyShareOf(90m exact-distance) + loopiness + corridorDoublingRatio(350m exact lateral) — report-only except the arterial presentation tier; adversarially hardened (phase-aliasing + grid-phase defects found and fixed pre-baseline)
params.assembly_relax_caps: rung 5 (disclosed, last resort): overlap 0.45, uturns/spurs/microloops reject >=3, residential 0.30; fast-forward on zero-assembled iterations
params.closure_semantics: R18-2 fix: closure = start<->end self-closure (was distance-to-pin, which auto-rejected every loop from off-road pins, e.g. Hockley 346m); snap offset tracked + disclosed >150m, rejected >1500m
params.chain_generator: REFUSED for loops (pre-registered falsification: pool ctryVar 0.0004-0.0098 vs required >0.05; curvyShare +1pp vs +10pp bar; ms 11157 vs 6000 bar; AC held 19/48). Code + span-atomic repair machinery stay for A-to-B parity; revival = new pre-registered experiment on richer span material (post-R18-4 named-road merges).
params.atob_candidates: R18-3 parity: per-cluster candidates DRIVE the cluster best road (traversal span oriented by corridor progress; <1200m = touch) instead of off-road centroid; stops merge as progress-ordered units, never splitting a span; TSP skipped for span candidates
params.atob_trace: always-trace (fail-open): arterial/residential/country measured; grace at BOTH endpoints
params.bundles: twisty bar 0.20 | backroads 0.10 | scenic 0.35 + auto nice-to-have viewpoint | simple bar off (1.0) + tolerance 0.15 | default 0.50; aliases chill->simple, coffee_stop/avoid_highways->default; weights stay the frozen BD-30 vectors (tie-breakers)
params.location_intents: through <road> -> pinned repair-immune traversal span (migration 0010 pg_trgm lookup, kind-aware precedence: through=roads-first, near/avoid=towns-first); near <place> -> pinned point (anchor-snap <=3km else raw); avoid <place> -> 3km keep-away disc filtering segments/spots/anchors; measured Tier-2 rows (via >=60% vertices within 30m; near <=2km; avoid-miss renders RELAXED in v1 - ladder rung is the recorded follow-up); unresolved/out-of-reach -> honest disclosure
params.urban_bars: twisty 0.15 | backroads 0.12 | scenic 0.10 | default 0.25 | simple off — post-grace urban share; REPLACE the R18-4 arterial bars (BD-60: arterial-through-fields is fine)
params.closed_ring_exclusion: R21-0(a), migration 0013: retrieval excludes ST_IsClosed segments (cul-de-sac bulbs/circles) — fixes the Kuehne+Nagel/Standish U-turn (extends BD-18 to ALL closed rings); compute.ts isClosedRing guard for rebuilds
params.urban_share_measure: R21-0(b), migration 0014: DUAL-FLANK (inside-built OR both ±120m flanks built) on the retrievable class, replacing buffer-0 — kills the industrial parcel-gap collector blindness; pool 12,337→10,514
params.r21_disclosures: R21-4: presented best discloses u-turns, |durErr|>0.15, and loopiness<0.10 out-and-backs (informational, after status decision — no selection change)
